pattern: # Curated brand crosswalk for SNAP retailer names.
# pattern       normalized store name; matched as equality or longest prefix
#               so DOLLAR GENERAL absorbs DOLLAR GENERAL STORE / MARKET.
#               fuel_branded and generic resolve to ownership = unknown; see
# --- dollar stores (broken out as their own format) --------------------------
# Kroger's smaller regional banners. Patterns are deliberately narrow:
# BAKERS alone would swallow Bakersfield Grocery Outlet and Baker's IGA
# JAYC only ever matches Jaycees/Jaycee stores
# --- defunct / acquired chains (matter for the historical map versions) ------
# --- fuel brands: the banner says nothing about who owns the store -----------
